pending_interview.question: You are leading an AI engineering team embedded in a client organization. Six months into the engagement, a senior client stakeholder — someone whose buy-in is essential for the project's success — tells you privately that they have lost confidence in your team's technical direction, but they have not raised this concern through any official channel and have asked you to keep it between you. How do you handle it, and what do you do next?
